results.title: Iran offers to reopen Strait of Hormuz within two days if US meets demands
results.description: Iran says it can reopen the Strait of Hormuz within two days if the US ends its naval blockade and meets Tehran's demands under its proposed peace plan.

results.title: How Ukraine and Russia air raid apps were hacked to send fake radiation alert
results.description: Ukraine and Russia both claimed their emergency alert apps were hacked on Sunday (November 1) and were made to send false alerts to residents warning of air raids and fake radiation. The notifications startled people in both nations, but authorities said they cleared up the confusion in under an hour

results.title: Parliamentary Panel Reviews Pendency Of Child Sexual Offence Cases
results.description: A parliamentary committee on Monday reviewed the large number of pending sexual offence cases against children under the POCSO Act and the performance of fast-track courts in Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, Tamil Nadu, and Kerala. Data reveals over 2.45 lakh such cases are pending nationally, with many trials exceeding the one-year deadline.
